'''Shrike Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] stationed on [[Saffalore]], charged with defense of [[Lurark]]. They engaged in combat with and were defeated by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] while the elite [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilots were providing cover for a [[Wraith Squadron]] mission.
